# GitHub Copilot instructions

- Read `AGENTS.md` before proposing repository changes.
- The product is always a two-source composition: screen recording 1 plus speaker 2.
- Do not edit locked files under `vendor/portrait-talk-theme-kit/`.
- Change composition geometry only in `config/compositions.json` and keep exports in sync.
- Preserve zero runtime dependencies and local-only media processing.
- Run `npm run check` before completion.
